details.distanceMethod: The 2027 Lavaredo 120K page gives 120 km; the track embedded in the same page measures 120,753 m; the linked GPX measures 119.479 km horizontally and 120.484 km in three dimensions. This card uses the official 120 km and keeps the other figures in the body. The event has five races and this page is about the 120K only.
details.elevationMethod: The 2027 page gives 5,800 m of positive gain and the embedded track gives 5,364 m with 5,346 m of loss. The linked GPX yields 5,977 m of raw positive change and 5,961 m of raw negative change; a 3 m threshold gives only 829 m because the 12,316 points are sampled too densely for that filter. This card uses the official 5,800 m; file-based figures are shown in the body and are not averaged with it.
